description: Обзор сервисов Delivery по метрикам OTel: RED, Postgres, Kafka, Runtime.

panels.description: Серверная сторона по сервисам за выбранный диапазон: gateway — HTTP (ошибка = 5xx), order/user/product — gRPC (ошибка = статус != OK). p95 — по delta-гистограммам с линейной интерполяцией внутри бакета, точность — до бакета. Клик по сервису открывает Service Dashboard.
panels.title: Сводка по сервисам (RED, server)

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT ServiceName, MetricName, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c, sum(Count) AS reqs,
         sumIf(Count, if(MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration', toUInt16OrZero(Attributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 500, Attributes['rpc.response.status_code'] != 'OK')) AS errs
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('http.server.request.duration', 'rpc.server.call.duration') AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY ServiceName, MetricName
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.95 * reqs, cum) AS i FROM h WHERE reqs > 0
)
SELECT ServiceName AS service,
       reqs / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1) AS rps,
       errs / reqs AS error_rate,
       b[i - 1] + (if(i > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i]) - b[i - 1]) * (0.95 * reqs - cum[i - 1]) / c[i] AS p95
FROM q
ORDER BY service

panels.description: http.server.request.duration: число запросов в секунду по http.route.
panels.title: Gateway RPS по маршрутам

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['http.route'] AS route, sum(Count) / $__interval_s AS rps
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, route
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Доля ответов 5xx по http.route. 4xx ошибкой не считается.
panels.title: Gateway error rate (5xx)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['http.route'] AS route, sumIf(Count, toUInt16OrZero(Attributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 500) / sum(Count) AS error_rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, route
ORDER BY time

panels.description: p95 http.server.request.duration по бакетам гистограммы, с интерполяцией.
panels.title: Gateway p95 по маршрутам

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['http.route'] AS route, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY time, route
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arraySum(c) AS n, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.95 * n, cum) AS i FROM h WHERE n > 0
)
SELECT time, route, b[i - 1] + (if(i > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i]) - b[i - 1]) * (0.95 * n - cum[i - 1]) / c[i] AS p95
FROM q
ORDER BY time

panels.description: rpc.server.call.duration: число вызовов в секунду по сервису и rpc.method.
panels.title: gRPC RPS по методам

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS service, Attributes['rpc.method'] AS method, sum(Count) / $__interval_s AS rps
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'rpc.server.call.duration' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, service, method
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Доля вызовов с rpc.response.status_code != OK (например, NOT_FOUND).
panels.title: gRPC error rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS service, Attributes['rpc.method'] AS method, sumIf(Count, Attributes['rpc.response.status_code'] != 'OK') / sum(Count) AS error_rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'rpc.server.call.duration' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, service, method
ORDER BY time

panels.description: p95 rpc.server.call.duration по бакетам гистограммы, с интерполяцией.
panels.title: gRPC p95 по методам

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS service, Attributes['rpc.method'] AS method, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'rpc.server.call.duration' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY time, service, method
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arraySum(c) AS n, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.95 * n, cum) AS i FROM h WHERE n > 0
)
SELECT time, service, method, b[i - 1] + (if(i > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i]) - b[i - 1]) * (0.95 * n - cum[i - 1]) / c[i] AS p95
FROM q
ORDER BY time

panels.description: db.client.operation.duration: p95 по pgx.operation.type, с интерполяцией внутри бакета. Только сервисы с БД.
panels.title: Postgres p95 по операциям

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', Attributes['pgx.operation.type']) AS series, any(ExplicitBounds) AS b, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS c
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'db.client.operation.duration' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY time, series
), q AS (
  SELECT *, arraySum(c) AS n, arrayCumSum(c) AS cum, arrayFirstIndex(x -> x >= 0.95 * n, cum) AS i FROM h WHERE n > 0
)
SELECT time, series, b[i - 1] + (if(i > length(b), b[length(b)], b[i]) - b[i - 1]) * (0.95 * n - cum[i - 1]) / c[i] AS p95
FROM q
ORDER BY time

panels.description: pgxpool.acquired_connections / pgxpool.max_connections (argMax за интервал). Оба значения — текущее состояние, не накапливаются.
panels.title: Утилизация пула

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ServiceName, ' · ', Attributes['db.client.connection.pool.name']) AS series,
  argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquired_connections') / nullIf(argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'pgxpool.max_connections'), 0) AS utilization
FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName, MetricName, Attributes, TimeUnix, Value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquired_connections'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ServiceName, MetricName, Attributes, TimeUnix, Value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'pgxpool.max_connections'
)
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Delta pgxpool.acquire_duration (A) и pgxpool.empty_acquire_wait_time (B), делённые на число acquire за интервал, в секундах.
panels.title: Ожидание acquire

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS series,
  sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquire_duration') / 1e9 / nullIf(sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquires'), 0) AS wait
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('pgxpool.acquire_duration', 'pgxpool.acquires') AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, series
HAVING sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquires') > 0
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS series,
  sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'pgxpool.empty_acquire_wait_time') / 1e9 / nullIf(sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquires'), 0) AS wait
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('pgxpool.empty_acquire_wait_time', 'pgxpool.acquires') AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, series
HAVING sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'pgxpool.acquires') > 0
ORDER BY time

panels.description: pgxpool.empty_acquire в секунду: захваты, когда в пуле не было свободного соединения.
panels.title: Empty acquire /s

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS series, sum(Value) / $__interval_s AS rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'pgxpool.empty_acquire' AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time
